artifacts.description: The front-right child’s hand resting on the counter (bottom-right) shows malformed finger anatomy—fingers appear fused/unnaturally shaped and the knuckle structure is unclear.
The center-back child’s face and hair (middle of image) blend oddly: a strand of hair crosses the forehead and merges into the facial area with smeared/unclear edges, giving an implausible occlusion.
Several children have unusually large, glassy eyes with overly smooth, poreless skin (especially the front-right child), producing a doll-like, non-photographic facial realism inconsistency.

Reflections/lighting on the glass partition (upper center with fluorescent lights) don’t convincingly interact with the subjects—high-intensity reflected panels and smudges appear disconnected from expected glare and depth cues.

The image has a strong cinematic/processed look with uniform grain and softened detail across faces and clothing textures, consistent with AI-generated rendering rather than camera-specific noise and sharpness falloff.
